name: ghost
description: Ghost: sort, tag and annotate a Destiny 2 vault from DIM CSV exports, with Ghost weapon ratings (DIM wish lists, Aegis's Endgame Analysis, perk ratings)

scripts.test: node test/core.smoke.js && node test/security.test.js && node test/builds.test.js && node test/optimizer.test.js && node test/ratings.test.js
scripts.e2e: python build.py && python build.py --target hosted && node test/e2e.playwright.js && node test/ui.e2e.js && node test/security.e2e.js && node test/bungie.e2e.js && node test/builds.e2e.js && node test/optimizer.e2e.js && node test/ratings.e2e.js
scripts.gates: npm run audit && npm run secrets && npm test && npm run e2e
